title: Model 100 Traveling Salesman
description: 4 captured saves. Source only; format, dependencies, or incomplete code prevent stock BASIC loading.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Cassette name T
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Model 100 header/body framing and additive checksum; declared payload length; strictly increasing records; one consistent pointer base; exact record coverage of payload; exact left/right bytes

The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player.
versions.startupSource:
10 'traveling salesman
14  DEFSNG A
15 DEFINT B-Z
16 FC!=.9
20 INPUT "How many cites";C
30 DIM C(1,C)
40 INPUT"random sequence";R:FORI=1TOR:C(0,0)=RND(1):NEXTI
45 CLS
50 FORJ=0TO1:FORI=1TOC:C(J,I)=RND(1)*63:NEXTI,J
60 DIM N(C),R(C),A(C):FORI=1TOC:N(I)=I+1:NEXT I:N(C)=1
70 GOSUB 1000:AR=C*100
100 IF A(0) < AR THEN AR=A(0):FOR I=1TO C:R(I)=N(I):NEXTI:LINE(0,0)-(63,63),0,BF:II=1:FORI=1TOC:LINE(C(0,II),C(1,II))-(C(0,N(II)),C(1,N(II))),1:II=N(II):NEXTI:PRINT@280,INT(AR);
